info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Management API
info.description: The Loan Application Management API provides tools for updating existing loan applications in the system. This endpoint allows users to submit changes to specific loan application details, enhancing operational efficiency and accuracy. Financial institutions and service providers can utilize this API to streamline the management of loan applications and ensure that the latest information is reflected in their systems. Typical use cases include modifying borrower information, adjusting loan terms, or correcting application details.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of an existing loan application identified by the specified unique ID. Make sure to provide all necessary information in the request body to ensure a successful update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the loan application with the specified ID. Provide the necessary data for the update in JSON format.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the loan application has been updated.
